tagline.en: The Proxmox hypervisor in a container, for trying it without dedicating a machine — runs privileged
tagline.pt: O hypervisor Proxmox num container, pra experimentar sem dedicar uma máquina — roda privileged

proxmox-root-password.note: The `root` password for the Proxmox web interface. Upstream's default is the literal string `root`; this replaces it.

upstream.note: The image is `dockurr/proxmox` (two r's), the repository is `dockur/proxmox`. Without this line `updates.py` guesses the image name and finds nothing.
